## The New York bakery that started the cupcake craze now ships its most iconic treats to your door


Magnolia Bakery ships nationwide on Goldbelly. The Greenwich Village bakery that sparked the cupcake craze in 1996 — and whose banana pudding has millions of devoted fans around the world — delivers its most iconic treats straight to your door.


[Order Magnolia Bakery on Goldbelly](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/magnolia-bakery)


## **About Magnolia Bakery**


Founded in 1996 on Bleecker Street in New York City’s West Village, Magnolia Bakery became a phenomenon when its cupcakes appeared on HBO’s Sex and the City. Lines formed around the block. Long before social media, it was one of the first foods to go viral. Today Magnolia has locations worldwide, but it’s still a neighborhood bakery at heart — real ingredients, simple recipes, and the kind of baking that makes people seek it out wherever they are.


The banana pudding is what most people come for. The cupcakes are what made it famous. Both ship to your door.


## **What to Order from Magnolia Bakery**


### **World-Famous Banana Pudding**


This is Magnolia Bakery’s real claim to fame. Fresh bananas, Nilla Wafers, and a rich creamy pudding that’s indulgent but still light and somehow endlessly addictive. If you’ve never had it, start here. If you have, you already know.


**[Order Magnolia Bakery Banana Pudding](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/magnolia-bakery/classic-banana-pudding-multipack)**


### **Legendary Cupcake Assortment**


The cupcakes that put Magnolia on the map. Soft, tender cake with just the right amount of creamy buttercream frosting. This 12-pack includes four each of their best-selling flavors: Red Velvet, Vanilla, and Chocolate. The ones people waited an hour in line for in 1996.


**[Order Magnolia Bakery Cupcake Assortment](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/magnolia-bakery/i-cupcake-ny-assortment-12-count)**


### **Confetti Cake**


You don’t need a birthday to order this. Magnolia’s Confetti Cake is a vanilla cake with confetti layered into each layer, finished with pink buttercream and even more confetti on top. This 3-layer cake serves 6 to 8 people. Festive, fun, and exactly the kind of thing worth sending to someone who needs a celebration.


**[Order Magnolia Bakery Confetti Cake](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/magnolia-bakery/6-inch-confetti-cake)**


### **Carrot Cake**


One of Magnolia’s beloved classics. A rich, warmly spiced carrot cake frosted with their signature cream cheese buttercream. The kind of cake that converts people who think they don’t like carrot cake.


**[Order Magnolia Bakery Carrot Cake](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/magnolia-bakery/carrot-cake)**


### **Chocolate Cake**


Three layers of super-rich chocolate cake with silky chocolate buttercream. Pure, indulgent bliss. For the chocolate lover who doesn’t need a reason to celebrate but will gladly use this as one.


**[Order Magnolia Bakery Chocolate Cake](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/magnolia-bakery/6-inch-chocolate-cake)**


### **Best of Magnolia Bakery Sampler**


The best introduction to everything Magnolia makes. The sampler brings together their most iconic items in one order so you can try the full range without committing to one thing. The best first order if you’ve never ordered before.


**[Order Best of Magnolia Bakery Sampler](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/magnolia-bakery/best-of-magnolia-bakery-sampler-pack-small)**


[Browse All Magnolia Bakery on Goldbelly](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/magnolia-bakery)
